label: Violencia familiar
reason: Closest police category to IPV; also covers other relatives, all ages and sexes, so an upper bound for partner violence against women

code_or_value: Violencia de género en todas sus modalidades distinta a la violencia familiar
label: Gender violence other than family violence
reason: Can include partner violence outside the household (e.g. ex-partners, dating)

label: Femicide
reason: Most femicides are by partners or ex-partners, but the relationship is not recorded

label: Rape
reason: Sexual IPV is part of IPV; relationship and sex not recorded in carpetas

label: Sexual abuse
reason: Context only

label: Sexual harassment
reason: Context only (mostly non-partner)

label: Intentional injuries
reason: Partner assaults may be filed as lesiones instead of violencia familiar; victims file gives women 18+

label: Intentional homicide
reason: Women killed by partners may be classified as homicide, not femicide

label: Women 18+
reason: Only minors/adults split exists, so 15+ is impossible; 'No especificado' and 'No identificado' kept as women_age_unknown_*

label: Negligent injury / homicide
reason: Not intentional violence

label: Age in years
reason: CVEEDAD is the unit of Edad (5=years, 4=months, 3=days, 2=hours, 9=unknown); inferred from the data because the manual does not list it

label: Violencia familiar
reason: Partner violence is recorded under family violence (manual: family violence requires a relative or partner as aggressor)

label: Cónyuge/Pareja/Novia(o)
reason: IPV-specific: aggressor is spouse, partner or boyfriend/girlfriend

label: No especificado / blank
reason: Family-violence records with no relationship: partner count is a lower bound

label: Violencia no familiar
reason: Aggressor known without kinship or stranger; ex-partners should be coded as 3 'pareja' under family violence, but some may land here

label: Se dio aviso al Ministerio Público
reason: Health-to-justice referral; links the health and police sectors

label: Física; sexual; psicológica; económica/patrimonial
reason: Several types per record allowed

label: Violence by current/last partner in last 12 months
reason: 1=yes, 2=no, 9=not specified (kept in denominator); blank = never partnered. Reproduces INEGI's 20.7% of ever-partnered women

label: Violence over current/last relationship
reason: Filter for the help-seeking module

label: Woman with partner or ex-partner
reason: INEGI's denominator for partner-violence prevalence

label: Age
reason: Joined on ID_PER (all 110127 women match)

label: Asked an institution for support
reason: Asked of women with VPAR_A=1; refers to the whole relationship

label: Asked a Centro de Justicia para las Mujeres
reason: Survey counterpart of the CJM administrative counts

label: Asked a public clinic, health centre or hospital
reason: Survey counterpart of DGIS (public units)

label: Complaint to police / Ministerio Público
reason: Survey counterpart of SESNSP carpetas

label: Year of last request / complaint
reason: Proxy for 'within the reference period'; 8888=does not remember and 9999=not specified count as not recent
